doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Basie band with Nat Pierce and Joe Williams
summary: He recalls booking the Basie band while Basie was ill, when Joe Williams sat in.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. Of course, Mel, of which I saw the poster there, with Thad Jones and Mel Lewis... Multiple times had you hosted the band there? Or was it...
Yeah, a couple times down on Rush Street when they came through, yeah, yeah.
Oh, how was it? It was wonderful.
One of the great times was when I had the Basie Band when Basie was sick, and Nat Pierce played piano.
And Joe Williams happened to be in town, and he came and sat in. And like the whole South Side came down, it was wild. Even Freddie Green played a solo.
